title: Dispatch: qxnc spell-sourced bonded summons with one bond per caster per spell (Sonnet 5.5, attempt 1)
description:
Implement eshyra-qxnc (read it: bd show eshyra-qxnc). Parent integration bead: eshyra-qxnc. The captain has made every design decision below. Do not re-decide them. If the code or the SRD record contradicts any of them, stop and record the contradiction in your notes rather than improvising.

HARD RULE (bd memory srd-fidelity-hard-blocker): nothing may contradict the SRD. Source: packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json, records spell:find-familiar and spell:find-steed (data.duration "Instantaneous", data.description, data.mechanics.effects[0].identity {kind: persistent-linked, maximumLinked: 1}, initialState {presence: present, link: active}, transitions). Do NOT edit records.json or any importer file. This branch is stacked on eshyra-71u1 (PR #605): recastBondedSummon already selects transitions by presence.

## Source facts
- Find Familiar: "You can't have more than one familiar at a time. If you cast this spell while you already have a familiar, you instead cause it to adopt a new form."
- Find Steed: "You can't have more than one steed bonded by this spell at a time. As an action, you can release the steed from its bond at any time, causing it to disappear."
- Both are Duration Instantaneous. The bond persists through the record's persistent-linked identity, not through a duration.

## Today (survey)
- packages/core/src/state/activeEffects.ts createActiveEffect, spell-source block (~3425-3460): it throws "'<name>' is instantaneous per its record; instantaneous spells leave no active effect" for any instantaneous record. Record duration/concentration binding follows (recordDuration). Check every later use of recordDuration so an instantaneous record does not then refuse an until-removed duration.
- deriveZeroHpRule (~3119) already yields 'vanish-bonded' for the zero-hp-absence transition. deriveSummonCleanup (~3154) finds no spell-ended transition for these records, so policies default to remove/remove. That is correct: release and permanent dismissal make the creature disappear. vanish-bonded already requires campaignActorId (~3859).
- recastBondedSummon (~5270): checks row.source_kind === 'spell' && row.source_ref !== input.spellRef, so ruling bonds accept any spellRef. That is the defect.
- Today the tests create bonds as ruling-sourced: packages/core/test/bondedSummonRecast.test.ts setup().bond uses source {kind: 'ruling'} and atZeroHitPoints 'vanish-bonded'.
- Tool texts: packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolStartEffect.ts (the "Do NOT use this for instantaneous spells" sentence; the actors description "A ruling-sourced creature declares its rule with atZeroHitPoints: vanish-bonded for a familiar or steed"; the atZeroHitPoints property description) and toolRecastBondedSummon.ts. Run rg -n -i "ruling-sourced|vanish-bonded|familiar|steed" packages/core/src packages/cli/src docs and update every stale sentence (DM prompt text included, if any).

## Decision (captain, 2026-10-07)
1. Persistent-linked exception, decided by the record. In the spell-source block, an instantaneous record is allowed ONLY when input.kind is 'summoning' AND some entry of record.data.mechanics.effects has kind 'summoning', identity.kind 'persistent-linked' and initialState.link 'active'. Call that the bonded-summon effect. Otherwise keep today's refusal and message, unchanged. For an allowed record:
   a. The duration must be {kind: 'until-removed'}. Refuse anything else, saying the record bonds the creature until it is released or dismissed, so the effect lasts until removed.
   b. source.actor is required (the caster the creature is bonded to). Refuse its absence.
   c. The number of actors entries must be at least 1 and at most identity.maximumLinked (when it is a positive integer). Refuse otherwise.
   d. One bond per caster per spell. Refuse when another effect, not ended (active or suppressed), has source_kind 'spell', the same source_ref, and the same stored source actor (compare the engine's stored source_actor_kind/source_actor_ref after the same normalization this create applies; check how source.actor is normalized and resolve this input the same way before comparing), and holds an active actor link. The refusal names the existing effect and says casting the spell again while the bond lasts is recast_bonded_summon (Find Familiar reforms, Find Steed restores an absent steed), and that ending that effect releases the bond. An ended effect, or one whose links are all closed, does not block.
   e. Concentration is forbidden by the record (not concentration) and the 0-HP rule is derived ('vanish-bonded'), both through the existing path. A declared atZeroHitPoints that contradicts it is refused by the existing check.
2. Recast identity. In recastBondedSummon, right after the summoning-kind check, refuse an effect whose source_kind is not 'spell'. Say the bond was not recorded from its spell, so the engine cannot tell which spell created it, and a recast applies only to a bond created with start_effect source {kind: 'spell', ref}. The existing source_ref check then binds spellRef. Keep it, and keep its message.
3. Ruling-sourced 'vanish-bonded' stays legal at creation (homebrew bonded creatures). It just cannot be recast.
4. No migration, no new event kind, no root-export change.

## Texts and docs
- toolStartEffect.ts: say instantaneous spells leave no active effect EXCEPT a bonded summon whose record keeps a persistent link (Find Familiar, Find Steed). Those are spell-sourced with duration until-removed and source.actor = the caster, one bond per caster per spell. atZeroHitPoints is derived for them, and the ruling form is for homebrew bonded creatures.
- toolRecastBondedSummon.ts: the bond must have been created from its spell, and spellRef must be that spell.
- docs/active-effect-lifecycle.md: the recastBondedSummon paragraph, plus the creation/source-validation and vanish-bonded paragraphs (rg for "ruling" and "vanish-bonded"). Re-derive every sentence against the source text and the real tool contract.

## Evidence (packages/core/test/bondedSummonRecast.test.ts; adapt setup so bonds are spell-sourced with a caster source.actor; use whatever caster participant the harness can create, a character or a combatant)
Convert the existing tests to spell-sourced bonds (steed: spell:find-steed; familiar: spell:find-familiar), with no declared atZeroHitPoints, so the derived rule is exercised. The assertions themselves stay as they are. Add these cases, asserting identities and exact values and pinning no counts:
- A steed bond (spell:find-steed), recast with spellRef spell:find-familiar and form creature:owl, is refused (/was cast from/), and the actor is unchanged, both present and absent.
- A ruling-sourced vanish-bonded bond: creation succeeds, and a recast is refused with the new message.
- A second spell:find-familiar bond for the same caster is refused while the first is active, while its familiar is absent at 0 HP, and while the effect is suppressed. After end_effect on the first, a new bond succeeds. A different caster may hold its own bond at the same time.
- A spell:find-steed bond and a spell:find-familiar bond for the same caster coexist (different spells).
- Two actors entries on one Find Familiar bond are refused (maximumLinked 1).
- A missing source.actor is refused. A non-until-removed duration is refused.
- An instantaneous record without a persistent-linked summoning effect (e.g. spell:magic-missile with kind 'summoning') is still refused with the original instantaneous message.
- atZeroHitPoints 'vanish' declared on a Find Familiar spell bond is refused (contradicts the record).
- Run the whole suite. Other tests that create ruling vanish-bonded effects must stay green unchanged.

## Procedure
Work only in this worktree (/home/jhbongaarts/src/eshyra/.worktrees/eshyra-qxnc.1, branch eshyra-qxnc.1); use worktree paths only, never the parent checkout. Run npm run verify:worktree from the worktree root BEFORE committing (it rewrites files). It must be fully green, documented skips only. Commit on this branch with a message starting "eshyra-qxnc.1 " and ending with the line: Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
